front.title: Explicitly excluding objects from RPSL sets

abstract.t: This document updates RFC 2622 and RFC 4012 by defining the excl- members attribute on the as-set and route-set classes in the Routing Policy Specification Language (RPSL). A set that references another set includes everything the referenced set contains, however deeply nested. RPSL currently has no way for the set owner to make an exception. The excl-members attribute lets a set owner exclude specific members, including ones brought in by a referenced set.
